description: Request access to up to 5 vendor trust centers in one confirmed batch (requires trustlists_login). One confirm covers the list. Requests are enqueued one at a time. Do not invent a larger parallel farm. First call previews; call again with confirm: true to submit.

confirm.description: Must be true to enqueue the batch.

useCase.description: Shared reason for every request in the batch.

name: trustlists_access_request_batch
